2125355487470170612.en_summary: Cyberpunk 2077 looking more like extreme extrapolation of modern America: high tech low life. Parallels with tech/defense giants, corporate power, surveillance, wealth disparities, mentions Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Nvidia and SpaceX controlling critical infrastructure.
2125355487470170612.zh_summary: Cyberpunk 2077越來越像現代美國的極端外推：高科技低生活。與科技/防務巨頭、企業權力、監控、財富差距的平行，提到亞馬遜、微軟、谷歌、Nvidia和SpaceX控制關鍵基礎設施。

2125352890831368650.en_summary: The Nasdaq 100 fell 2% as renewed concerns over AI profitability and safety hit tech stocks, with Nvidia dropping 6% and Anthropic falling below its IPO price. Sentiment weakened on expectations of higher US tariffs on China, the EU and other economies, while S&P 500 edged lower despite most components rising.
2125352890831368650.zh_summary: 納斯達100指數下跌2%，因為對AI盈利能力和安全的關注重新升溫打擊科技股，Nvidia下跌6%，Anthropic跌破其IPO價。對美國對中國、歐盟及其他經濟體征收更高關稅的預期使情緒轉弱，標普500小幅下跌，盡管大多數成份股上漲。

2125352739236634664.en_summary: Alimentation Couche-Tard reported Q2 revenue of $22.5 bln, above $21.25 bln estimate, adjusted EPS $0.84 above $0.79, adjusted net income $771 mln above $734 mln. Net income $691.3 mln, gross profit $3.5 bln, merchandise and service revenue $4.8 bln, US comparable merchandise revenue up 1.8%.
2125352739236634664.zh_summary: Alimentation Couche-Tard報告第二季收入225億美元，高於212.5億美元預期，調整後每股盈利0.84美元高於0.79美元，調整後淨利潤7.71億美元高於7.34億美元。淨利潤6.913億美元，毛利潤35億美元，商品和服務收入48億美元，美國可比商品收入上升1.8%。
